preconditions.description: The number of vertices n must be between 2 and 1000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= x_i <= n and 1 <= y_i <= n and x_i != y_i for x_i, y_i in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge must connect two distinct vertices within the range of 1 to n.
The number of edges must be exactly n - 1 to form a tree.

postconditions.description: The output must be the vertex r, which is the location of Kuroni's hotel.
